en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Suleyman Bin Sama’at, from Ali Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Hakeym who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘If a man were to die whilst Fasting during the journey, I<sup>asws</sup> would not Pray over him’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from Sulayman ibn Sama‘ah, from Ali ibn ‘Isma‘il from Muhammad ibn Hakim who has said the following:
“I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘If a man while on a journey and fasting dies, I will not perform Salat (prayer) (of dead people) for him.’”
